tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /sa skya pa'i srung ma khyad par can rnams kyi rtsa ba'i sngags sogs kyi don bshad pa sngon gyi dpe rnying yid ches can du byas pa las bshus pa bzhugs// na mo buddha dhwa dza ye/ oṃ ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa sogs te/ rdo rje rtse mor/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par brjod/ /mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes pa ltar las/ skabs 'dir dpal dang bkra shis kyi don du sbyar ro/ /mahā ni chen po/ kā la ni dus sam/ nag po la 'jug pa las/ 'dir nag po/ ya na a bod pa la'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyi zhes bos pa ste/ nag po chen po ka ye zhes 'bod pa'o/ /shā sa na bstan pa/ u pa nye ba/ ha ri ṇe bsgrub pa'am 'dzin pa/ a ṣa ni paṇa chen ma tis 'dis par bsgyur kyang / nam bzang gis 'di rnams su bsgyur pa nyid 'thad do/ /a pishtsa mahā kā la ni/ paṇa chen ma tis/ phyi ma'i dus su zhes par bsgyur kyang / a ba tshig pashtsi ma rgyab dang phyi ma sogs la 'jug kyang don 'gyur tsam du song ba yin gyi 'thad par bsgyur na nub tu 'gyur/ kā la dus pas nam bzang gis ma nub pa'i dus zhes par bsgyur pa nyid shin tu legs so/ /a yam̐ ni 'dir zhes pa ste mdor na nag po chen po zhes bos nas bstan pa nye bar 'dzin pa'am/ bsgrub pa'i gang zag 'di rnams ma nub pa'i dus 'dir zhes pa'o/ /i daṃ ni 'dis zhes pa ste gdug pa can zhes pa'i don to/ /ratna tra ya ni dkon mchog gsum la'o/ /a pa gnod pa/ ka ri ṇaṃ byed pa/ ya ta gal te/ pra ti dzñām̐ dam bcas pa/ sma ra si gyis la zhes te/ mdor na gdug pa can 'dis gal te dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed na dam bcas pa dran par gyis la zhes pa'i don to/ /ta thā tshe/ i daṃ 'di/ duṇṭaṃ gdug 'di yan chad rje kun dga' bzang pos mdzad zer ba dpe rnying la 'dug

pa can/ kha kha zo zo/ khā hi khā hi zo zhig zo zhig yang rje btsun gyi dgongs don ltar na nges par zo/ ma ti'i dgongs pa bza' ru chug mā ra mā ra sod sod/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa zungs zungs/ ha na ha na snun snun zhes pa la/ rje btsun gyis 'bar ba rnon po/ dpang los rgyob rgyob/ da ha da ha sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa tshos tshos/ di na me ke na nyi ma gcig gi zhes pa la rje btsun gyis don nyin zhag gcig ma bzhag ma ra ya bsad par mdzod ces pa la/ dpang los bsad par gyis su byas te don 'dra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ni gdug pa dngangs shing gsod byed pa'i/ /hūm̐ ni mchog tu dran par byed/ /ces pa'i don no/ /phaṭ phaṭ ni 'phrin las kyi tshig ste/ phaṭ ni 'joms byed dgra yin te/ /grogs dang bcas pas 'joms par byed/ /ces so/ /sngags don lugs gcig go /oṃ mahā nag po chen po/ kā la ya/ shā sa na/ bstan pa/ u pa nye bar bsgrub pa/ ha ri ṇa/ e 'dis/ ṣa pishtsa mā kā phyi ma'i dus su/ la/ a 'di dang / yam̐/ i 'dir ni/ daṃ/ ratna dkon mchog gsum la/ tra yā/ a gnod pa byed pa rnams/ pa ka ri ṇam̐/ gal te/ ya ti/ pra ti dzñām̐/ dam bcas pa na/ sma dran par gyis de'i/ ra sitta dā/ i gdug pa can/ daṃ/ duṣṭam̐/ kha kha/ zo zo/ khā hi khā hi/ bza' ru chug gnyis/ mā ra sod gnyis/ mā ra/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ zungs gnyis/ bandha chings gnyis/ bandha/ ha na snun gnyis/ ha na/ da ha da sregs gnyis/ ha/ pa tsa pa tshos gnyis/ tsa/ dī na me nyi ma gcig gi ke na/ mā ra ya bsad par mdzod/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kā la nag po chen po/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kā la nag po chen po'i ched du/ ya hūm̐ rgya dpe bdun la gtugs/ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ sngags don lugs gcig go /oṃ mahā kā nag po chen po la/ la ya/

shā sa na bstan pa la gnod par byed pa/ sa ha ri ṇe/ e 'di/ ṣa a phyi ma yin pa/ pishtsa ma lo/ ya mi 'di dang 'di/ daṃ/ ta de/ ratna tra yā pa dkon mchog gsum la/ kā ri ṇe/ gnod par byed pa/ ya di gal te khyod/ satwaṃ/ pra ti sngon gyi dam bca'/ dzñām̐/ sma ra dran na/ si/ ta de'i tshe/ sa i 'di gdug pa can/ daṃ duṣṭam̐/ kha kha/ zo gnyis/ khā hi khā zo zhig gnyis/ hi/ mā ra mā ra/ sod gnyis/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ zungs gnyis/ bandha bandha chings gnyis/ ha na snun gnyis/ ha na/ da ha da ha/ sregs gnyis/ pa tsa pa tshos gnyis/ tsa/ dī na nyi ma gcig gi me ke na/ hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐/ oṃ mahā kā la nag po chen po la/ ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ snying po yi ge bcu gnyis pa/ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ mahā nag po chen po/ kā la hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po yi ge bdun pa/ lha mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ ro ru ro sgra dbyangs kyi nga ro sgrog pa/ ru/ bi tishaṭha/ mi brtan pa/ ba dho gnod pa spro la/ t+si/ kā ma chu skyes ma/ la rakṣa srin mo/ si/ hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ 'di la rgya dpe ma rnyed/ lugs gcig la/ oṃ ro ru sgra sgrogs gnyis/ ro ru bi mi brtan pa/ tiṣṭha/ ba gsod par/ dhot+si ka ma la spro ma/ rakṣa sī hūm̐ bhyaḥhūm̐/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ring thung / oṃ mahā kā chen po nag po/ la kā la/ bi kaṭṭa ka ra la/ mche ba gtsigs pa can/ lambi mchu 'phyang ba can/ ta e tha/ lamba ka be shugs chen po can/ ga lamba ka wā la/ byis pa'i gzugs can/ ra wī ghaṇṭa/ dril bu'i sgra can/ ru tra ma la bi drag po'i phreng ba can/ hu re/ tshe ha ka ha le gcod pa la dpa' ba can/ na ha le/ piṃ bi dza li/ ming gi rnam grangs can/ bā me kuṇṭa dha ri yam̐/ g.yon na bum pa 'dzin pa can/

ma eṃ/ da hi g.yas na ral gri dang gri gug can/ na kirta ka ro ḍi/ bi bhi ṣa na dha eṃ/ 'jigs su rung ba 'gyogs pa can/ bā me pū la pā ṇi phyag g.yon na mdung can/ ha ra dho tshangs skud can/ ra/ na ra mi mgo'i phreng ba can/ si ra/ mā la pa ta le kṣeṃ kā sa 'og na kṣiṃ sgrog pa/ ra ka la/ mahā po ṭa la chen po la/ po ṭā le/ mahā nag po chen po/ kā la shrī gangs ti se na/ ka bi lā se/ kṣe tra zhing skyong ba/ pā la/ ha hā ka ha ha sgrog pa/ ra hūm̐ hūm̐ ka hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrog pa/ re/ surba bha sha sngar gyi skad du/ bhi uṃ/ dzau gang gi go na/ dzanti/ mā sa sha chen/ bha ta zan/ phulla me tog dhu pa/ bdug spos/ i ga ha/ gtor ma 'di khyer cig ba liṃ dzi gha ha/ zo zhig da sha dika utta ra wu ri/ phyogs bcu dang byang na bzhugs pa'i/ ḍombhi ni/ g.yung mo/ tsaṇḍa li/ gtum mo/ rakkha si/ srin mo/ siṅga li siṅga li ma/ de wi/ lha mo/ ha na ha na/ snun gnyis/ bandha bandha/ chings gnyis/ mā ra mā ra/ sod gnyis/ da ha da ha/ sregs gnyis/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tshos gnyis/ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ le hi ba liṃ/ gtor ma longs la/ de hi siddhi/ dngos grub stsol/ sngags ring ngo / /oṃ mahā kā la kā la yab rkyang gi sngags/ ra ṭi ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ sngags thung ngo / /sa i yam̐ tsakra'i man ngag sa ka ra la hi yam̐/ sa hu bam̐/ ghri ta/ kī li kī la ya/ bi dhi sha na pā ta ya 'di yan no/ /na ma/ oṃ mahā kā la kā la bī ka la ra tri ta/ ḍombhi ni/ tsaṇḍa li/ rakkha sī/ saṅgi li hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ yab yum sbags te bsgrub pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ mahā kā la kā la bī kā la ra tri ta hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ḍombhi ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ rakṣa sī hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ siṅga li hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab yum so sor bsgrub pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ u tsa ṭa tsa ṭe swāhā/ dpal ngag gi dbang po'i phyag dpe las bshus pa'o zer ba dpe rnying na 'dug grong khyer bskyod pa'i sngags so/ /a li pho'i bod pa/ a li ma dza dza/ am̐ ge am̐ ge zhung skad/ dga'am legs pa bzang ba/ sham̐ sha las bsgrub song / li shi ded/ a sho ded/ rgan rgon song zhung skad/ mo rmugs bu/ zhung skad/ sha ti/ pu gri a li ma dza dza/ song / nag mo sha la rub dza dza/ bod skad sor bzhag dhika bzung / pho'i rbad pa/ ya dh-ika ya/ rgya skad/ du pa zhags pa/ sha ni sod/ rgya skad/ dum̐ shika tshur shog a gad dza/ mon lo tshur shog bu a gad dza/ sha ti/ ya nri dgra ya nri mon bu dza/ mon rtsa med/ mo khrag shwi/ la 'jib/ lce'i/ dza nṛ pho'i bsad pa/ ṇa dgra/ rbad/ du na 'di/ rbad/ bdud/ shi na rbad/ shaka shika rbad/ tri na rbad/ bgegs/ du bdud/ na rbad/ mon drag po/ bu ru tra/ sham̐ rbad lo ki shwa ra/ yam̐ rmugs/ rlung / liṃ 'dus/ sa/ kham̐ chu/ shod pa ya mo dza/ o che ge mo rus khrol khrol rbad/ gser gyi spu gri che ge mo'i srog la yam̐ rbad/ oṃ ro mo'i bod pa/ ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shukme/ ma hūm̐ ma bhyoḥdza dza/ traka rakṣa/ mo'i rbad pa/ kha/ mun tra ru lu ru lu traka rakṣa snying khrag snying bhyoḥ 'di dag gi 'bru re re la mchan yod pa rnams sa bon yin/ mchan med pa phal cher bod skad sor bzhag dang / rgya skad dang / mchan yod 'ga' re zhang zhung gi skad du'ang 'dug pu ta pu ti bhyoḥ sha sha traka sha sha traka tra mo tra pa/ snying khrag traka mo tra pa/ che ge mo ma ra ya phaṭ/ oṃ mahā mo'i bsad pa/ rakṣa srin mo chen mo'i snying /

tsitta srog trum̐ trum̐/ ka ma la rakṣa srin mo'i snying / tsitta srog trum̐ trum̐/ gu hye rakṣa gsang ba'i srin mo'i snying / tsitta srog trum̐ trum̐/ hri beṃ rakṣa srin pho'i snying / tsitta srog trum̐ trum̐/ ma ma tsa phur tsitta srog trum̐ trum̐/ su ru tsa lhum̐ tsitta srog trum̐ trum̐/ pho'i bod pa'i sngags 'di/ shas cher zhang zhung gi skad du 'dug pa la zhung skad kyi mchan bu sna gnyis btab yod/ bod pa zhes pa 'bod pa'i brda yin/ las mgon pho'i bod pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams rgya skad bod skad 'dres ma yod pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i ma mo'i rgyud rnams na yod pa dang cha 'dra 'dug pas phal cher gter ma'i nang nas 'byung ba 'dra/ traka rakṣa dang / sha sha dang / snying khrag zer ba yod pa'i sngags 'di rnams drag sngags shin tu zab pa rnams su yong gin 'dug pho'i bod pa zer kyang pha ma ming sring rnams kyi srog snying yin pa 'dra ste/ zhang zhung gi skad bod skad du don 'gyur byas na/ dga' ba dga' mo shog shog rgan rgon li shi ded/ a sho ded/ mo rmugs bu mo dga' mo shog shog nag mo sha la zhen pa shog shog zer bar 'gro ba 'dra ste/ zhang zhung gi skad dang bstun no/ /mu rmu spu gri dang / mo rmugs spu gri dang / mo rmug pu gri zer ba'i mo rmug bu mo ste/ pu tri yin pa 'dra zhing sha la gtub zer ba 'ga' yong gin 'dug na'ang / sha la rub zer ba 'di dag pa 'dra ste bsnyen pa'i skabs su 'dug pas so/ /a li zhes pa dga' ba dang / legs pa dang / bzang ba dang gang bder byas kyang rung / 'bod pa ming gi snying po zhes pa lha de'i ming gtso ba gcig yong ba yin no/ /bu tra bu/ bha dra bzang po/ pu tri bu mo rnams rgya skad/ sham̐ sham̐ rgan rgon pha ma la zer ba zhung skad/ a shwa rgya skad kyi rta yin/ zhung skad la bu yin nam snyam/ li shi 'jol sgeg dkar po zhung skad kyi yin nam snyam ste/

de ltar na rgan rgon sgeg chos mkhan dkor ded dang / ded la ma mo smug mo'i bu mo bzang mo shog shog ces pa ste sring mo la pho nya 'chol ba'i tshig go /pu tri byas na bu mo/ spu gri byas na phyag mtshan te gnyis ka sring mo la 'jug pas gang bde rung ba 'dra ste ma 'dres par bya'o/ /mo'i bod rbad bsad gsum thams cad ma mo za 'og gi gos gyon byu ru'i lan tshar can/ re ma ti'i rigs shig yin par bshad pa de'i sngags kho nar gda'o/ /tshul 'di rje rdo rje 'chang sogs rje btsun bla ma 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi gsung kho na lags pas kun gyi yid brtan gnas su mdzod/ ces pa 'di ni sngon gyi dpe rnying yid ches can du byas pa rnams las zhal bshus legs par byas te sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gzhan la phan phyir bkod pa 'di la bka' srung rnams dgyes par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ rang lo bcu dgu sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi/ lon pa'i yos kyi lo'i/ /zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum rmi lam du/ /'khor 'gas bskul nas bltas tshe sa skya yi/ /shar ri'i rtse la 'ja' sprin nam sprin nag me phung dbus/ /gur mgon lha brgyad gsal por yang yang mthong / mgon po gsal po byung pa dran/ gzhan rnams gsal po ma byung / /bzang rgyu med de sems kyi 'khrul snang ste/ /sems kyang skye med yin phyir brjod bral yin/ /ngan rgyu'ang med de sems kyi sgrib pa 'ga'/ /dag pa'i dag snang yin par thag bcad na/ /de 'drar 'gyur zhes bdag gi bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ gsungs/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang lo nyer bdun yan mgon po'i bsnyen pa byas tshad kyi grangs brtsis pa'i/ la gur gyi mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma 'bum phrag bzhi bcu ste sa ya bzhi dang / khri phrag drug song zhing sbyin sreg kyang smin rgyas byas pa/

da dung bye bsnyen lag tu long bar shog mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la byang chub bar du srungs shig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sa skya pa'i srung ma khyad par can rnams kyi rtsa ba'i sngags sogs kyi don bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
